design_philosophy.concept: Nordisk Presisjon møter Diskré Luksus (Nordic Precision meets Understated Luxury)
pillars: Fjord & Granitt: Dype, rolige mørke flater (#070B0E, #0D1318) uten støyende gradienter
Børstet Messing (Nordic Brass #CBA365 / #DDB77A): Reservert eksklusivt for handlinger, aktive valg og signatur-markører
Snø & Frost (Ivory #F4F4F0 & Ice Mist #8A96A0): Krystallklar lesbarhet med APCA-godkjent kontrast
Funksjonell Taktilitet: Glassmorfisme med ekte optisk dybde (backdrop-blur-2xl + 1px hairline border) på kunde-flater, og skarp 'Aviation HUD'-ergonomi på sjåfør-flaten

anti_ai_slop_rules: DO NOT use generic centered layouts or symmetrical card grids.
DO NOT use full-screen purple/blue SaaS gradient meshes (#7351B7 is forbidden).
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto for headers. Maintain Fraunces (warm editorial serif) for Display & Headings, Inter Tight for clean compact UI body, and JetBrains Mono for numbers/prices/timers.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds behind headers, dropdowns, or bottom sheets. Always provide high-opacity backing (min 88% alpha) with backdrop-blur-2xl and 1px hairline border.
DO NOT add universal CSS transitions like 'transition: all'. Explicitly transition transform, opacity, background-color, or border-color.
DO NOT center-align the application container or body text. Preserve natural left-aligned editorial scanning flow.
DO NOT use standard emoji icons (🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🚗) for UI components. Use Lucide icons or custom SVG glyphs.
Use 2x-3x more deliberate whitespace (p-4 to p-6) inside bounded cards to prevent text colliding with container borders.
All interactive elements and key informational blocks MUST have unambiguous data-testid attributes for reliable end-to-end testing.

platform_constraints.stack: React 18 (.jsx/.js), Tailwind CSS v3, MapLibre GL JS v6 / MapTiler, Lucide React, Framer Motion
platform_constraints.file_type_instruction: All components must be written as .jsx / .js JavaScript files. Do not generate TypeScript (.tsx) files.
platform_constraints.viewport: Mobile-first native phone shell (390px-430px wide, max-w-[440px] centered on desktop, 100dvh).
platform_constraints.safe_areas: Must honor env(safe-area-inset-top) and env(safe-area-inset-bottom) for iPhone dynamic island and Android gesture bar.

markers.user_location: Pulsing concentric ring: outer ripple (rgba(203,163,101,0.25) -> scale 2.4), inner solid brass ring, white core dot (#F4F4F0)
markers.pickup_pin: Nordic teardrop pin in Champagne Gold (#CBA365) with dark core and white center dot, subtle black drop-shadow
markers.dropoff_pin: Deep Obsidian pin (#0B1013) with Gold outline and 3x3 checkered finish-line flag emblem in Gold/Ivory
markers.nearby_cars: Isometric metallic vehicle glyph in deep graphite (#171A1E) with subtle gold edge highlight (#CBA365) and 360-degree heading rotation animation
markers.active_trip_car: Hero vehicle with prominent brass halo glow, active headlights cone casting subtle amber beam forward

layout_architecture.spec: Interactive 3D MapLibre map centered on user position (default Oslo S / Karl Johan). Shows live nearby cars refreshing every 6s, pulsing user beacon, and smoothly fits bounds with 320px bottom padding when a route is computed.

Three floating crystal pills: (Left) Hamburger Menu button with haptic tap; (Center) Brand mark 'KJAPP' in serif with gold accent dot; (Right) KJAPP Assist pulse orb button routing to AI concierge. Background: rgba(12,18,22,0.85) with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px hairline border.
Pulsing Gold Sparkles FAB. Initiates voice/AI trip booking or smart requests. Includes animated breathing halo.

layout_architecture.zone: 4. Interactive Bottom Sheet (Two States: Idle Search vs Route Review)
layout_architecture.spec: Draggable/collapsible crystal container with rounded-[24px]. Contains drag handle bar (44x4px, rgba(232,224,208,0.22)).

state_A_idle_search.description: User has not yet selected a destination

elements.ui: Horizontal pill showing current location (default: 'Din posisjon' or reverse-geocoded street name). Left gold beacon dot, right 'Endre' link in gold. Tapping opens pickup address search sheet.
Live status pill: pulsing emerald/brass dot, 'X biler i nærheten · nærmeste Y min'. Updates in real-time.

Hero card inviting destination input. Displays dynamic Nordic time-of-day greeting ('God kveld, Martin'), large serif title 'Hvor vil du?', and a prominent circular search button. Tapping opens full-screen SearchSheet.
3-column grid of frequent destinations. Hjem (Home icon), Jobb (Briefcase), Flyplass (Plane). One-tap automatically plots route to Oslo Lufthavn Gardermoen or saved addresses.
3-column preview card strip showing KJAPP (Standard), KJAPP+ (Premium), and KJAPP XL with custom metallic vehicle glyphs and micro-taglines before dropoff is picked.

state_B_route_review.description: Destination chosen; route plotted on map with real distance & ETA

elements.ui: Vertical timeline spine: Brass dot (Pickup) -> 1px line -> Ivory square (Dropoff). Address names truncated cleanly with an 'Endre' button on the right to revert to search.

Horizontally scrollable snap carousel with 4 tiers: Standard, Sparsom, Komfort, and Premium. Each card has: SVG vehicle silhouette with metallic gradient and alloy rims, class name, passenger capacity (Users icon), ETA (min), price in bold serif (XXX kr), and a gold checkmark when active.
Dual-column readout: Left shows 'X.X km · sjåfør kan hente deg om Y min'. Right shows 'Ca. pris' in tiny overline, and large 26px Fraunces price in Norwegian kroner.
Selectable payment method row showing Credit Card / Vipps / Apple Pay, card brand icon, last 4 digits, and a green 'Verifisert' badge. Tapping allows changing payment or adding card.

Full-width pill button: 'Bestill bilen · XXX kr'. Glowing brass gradient with shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgba(203,163,101,0.35)]. When clicked, shows animated spinner and transitions seamlessly into the live trip state.

search_sheet_modal.ui: Full-screen frosted backdrop with instant auto-focus on input field. Displays user's saved/favorite places with star icon first, followed by live debounced Norwegian address search (geocoding via backend API) with map-pin icons.

states.ui: Pulsing radar rings in brass gold, animated dots ('Søker sjåfør...'), trip destination summary, and 'Avbryt søk' link.

Circular ETA badge showing arrival minutes, driver avatar with rating, car model and license plate (e.g., 'Tesla Model Y · EK 12345'), and 3 action pills: Ring (Phone), Melding (Chat), Sikkerhet (Safety/Share trip).
Map camera follows active car sprite. Bottom card shows destination, live price, trip distance & duration, and quick button to chat with driver.
Automatic celebration checkmark and redirect to receipt.

customer_menu.spec: Slide-over drawer from left with user initials avatar, 'KJAPP-medlem' status badge, categorized navigation (Din reise, KJAPP-medlem, Verktøy), and dedicated driver/løyvehaver onboarding entry points.

requirements: Glanceable high-contrast HUD design (zero fluff, optimized for in-car phone mount at arm's length)
Large high-visibility 'Online / Offline' toggle pill with emerald pulse animation when active
Driver greeting with today's completed trips count and revenue total in Norwegian kroner
Active trip card with direct navigation link if a trip is currently assigned

Incoming trip request card with 15-second countdown progress bar (smooth color transition from gold to urgent red in final 5s), passenger rating, pickup/dropoff addresses, driver net payout, and large dual 'Avslå' / 'Godta tur' touch targets (min 56px height)
Compact 4-cell metric grid: I dag (kr), Turer, Online tid, Godta-rate
Fixed one-hand driver bottom navigation bar: Hjem, Inntekt, Turer, Konto
Cockpit turn-by-turn map orientation with high zoom level (zoom 15-16, pitch 55)
Clear step-by-step state machine: 'Kjører til henting' -> 'Ankommet hentested' -> 'Start tur' -> 'Fullfør tur'
Slide-to-confirm or large tactile confirmation button to prevent accidental clicks while moving
Emergency one-tap quick-dial to passenger or dispatch

principles: Physics-based spring curves (stiffness: 300, damping: 28) for bottom sheet expansions and modal slides.
Subtle pulsing animations (2.4s ease-out) for live GPS indicators and driver status radar.
Tabular number transitions (tabular-nums) for trip prices, countdowns, and distance meters to avoid layout shift.
Snappy vehicle selection switch: 150ms border highlight and soft brass ambient glow.

implementation_checklist_for_home: Verify MapLibre container fills 100dvh with responsive bottom padding (padding: { bottom: 320 }) when route is fitted.
Ensure top floating header bar uses backdrop-blur-2xl with opaque base (rgba(12,18,22,0.85)) so map elements don't clash behind it.
Ensure the where-to search card features the Nordic time-based greeting, search icon pill, and live vehicle count indicator.
Verify vehicle category picker supports touch horizontal swipe with scroll-snap-align: start.
Confirm that all interactive buttons (home-menu, home-where-to, quick-Hjem, vehicle-ai-first, booking-confirm) contain strict data-testid tags.
Verify payment status badge indicates verification state clearly prior to triggering booking request.
